voice._note: Chatterbox TTS. Two-step: POST /api/tts returns {url:'/outputs/<id>.wav'}, then GET base+url for the WAV, which auto-deletes on download. emotionExaggeration is deliberately low (0.35) because Professor Croc is deadpan; 0 is flat, 1 is theatrical. The [narration] tag in the text template selects Chatterbox's narration delivery. run.py transcodes the WAV to mp3 with ffmpeg.

image._note: Media Gen MCP (Meta AI images). Two-step: POST /api/image returns {urls:[cdn-webp-url]}, then GET that URL. No key required; if you mint one, set it as the SERVICE_KEY secret and it is sent as a Bearer header. Returns WebP at whatever aspect Meta chooses, so run.py scales+crops to 1920x1080 jpg. mode 'thinking' is higher quality and slower than 'instant'.
